import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # horizontal full lines (rows uniformly one non-bg color) ; vertical full lines
    hr=[[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]]; vc=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg]
    hlines=[(r,g[r][0]) for r,_ in hr]; vlines=[(c,g[0][c]) for c,_ in vc]
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for val,r0,r1,c0,c1 in shapes(g,bg):
        best=None
        for lr,lv in hlines:
            dist=r1-lr if lr<r1 else -(lr-(r0+1)) if lr>r0 else 0
            best=(dist,lr) if best is None or dist<best[0] else best
        if best is None: continue
        dist,lr=best
        # direction: line above -> move down; below -> move up; same -> none
        if lr<r0: dr=-1*(r1-lr)   # move down so bottom touches line
        elif lr>r1: dr=+(r0+1-lr) # move up so top touches line
        else: dr=0
        nr0,nr1=r0+dr,r1+dr
        # stripe: perpendicular full extent on far side from line
        if lr<r0: nst=nr1+1      # stripe below new shape
        else: nst=nr0-1          # stripe above
        if 0<=nst<h: o[nst]=[8]*w
        for a in range(nr0,nr1+1):
            for b in range(c0,c1+1): o[a][b]=8
        for a in range(r0,r1+1):
            for b in range(c0,c1+1): o[a][b]=bg
    return o

def shapes(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                val=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); comp.append((a,b)); seen[a][b]=True
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==val: stack.append((na,nb))
                out.append((val,min(a for a,b in comp),max(a for a,b in comp),min(b for a,b in comp),max(b for a,b in comp)))
    return out

    print(k,'match' if ok else 'MISMATCH')

G=load(); i1,o1,i2,o2,i3,o3=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output'],G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output'],G['Demo pair 3 input'],G['Demo pair 3 output']
ti=G['Test input']

def f2(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    lines_h=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    lines_v=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[i][c] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    vis=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    objects=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not vis[i][j]:
                val=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b)); vis[a][b]=True
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not vis[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==val: st.append((na,nb))
                r0=min(a for a,b in comp); r1=max(a for a,b in comp)
                c0=min(b for a,b in comp); c1=max(b for a,b in comp)
                objects.append((val,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    # pick nearest line to object bounding box (perpendicular distance of bbox edge)
    def gap(ob, kind, lineidx):
        val,r0,r1,c0,c1=ob
        if kind=='h':
            d = abs(lineidx-r0)-1 if lineidx>r0 else (abs(lineidx-r1)-1 if lineidx<r1 else 99)
            return d
        else:
            d = abs(lineidx-c0)-1 if lineidx>c0 else (abs(lineidx-c1)-1 if lineidx<c1 else 99)
            return d
    # candidates: all lines x objects; use min total? shape itself... choose by per-shape min gap then min gap among shapes
    best=None
    for ob in objects:
        for kind,lidx in [('h',l) for l in lines_h]+ [('v',c) for c in lines_v]:
            dg=gap(ob,kind,lidx)
            key=(dg,) if best is None or key<best[0] else key
            best=(key,ob,kind,lidx)
    d,ob,kind,lidx=best
    val,r0,r1,c0,c1=ob
    if kind=='h':
        # vertical move so top becomes lidx+1 if line below shape, else bottom -> lidx-1
        if lidx>r1: nr0=nr1=None; 
        shift = -(r0-(lidx+1)) if lidx>r1 else (r1-lidx-1*-1) 
        # clean:
        if lidx > r1: shift = -r0 + lidx + 1   # top -> lidx+1
        else:           shift = -r1 + lidx - 1   # bottom -> lidx-1
        sr = r1 + shift + 1
    else:
        if lidx < c0: shift = lidx + 1 - c0     # left -> lidx+1
        else:          shift = lidx - 1 - c1    # right -> lidx-1
        sc = c1 + shift + 1
    # erase original cells of shape, draw copy at new pos, strip
    return out,d,val,r0,r1,c0,c1,shift,kind,sr,sc,lidx,h,w

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    hrw=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in g[r])]
    hcw=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[i][c]==2 for i in range(h))]
    horiz = bool(hrw)
    line = hrw[0] if hrw else hcw[0]
    vis=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=2 and not vis[i][j]:
                val=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); comp.append((a,b)); vis[a][b]=True
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not vis[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==val: st.append((na,nb))
                comps.append(comp)
    # largest non-line component
    obj=max(comps,key=len); val=g[obj[0][0]][obj[0][1]]
    rs=[a for a,b in obj]; cs=[b for a,b in obj]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    if horiz:
        sr = r1+1 if line<r0 else r0-1
        for b in range(w): out[sr][b]=8
    else:
        sc = c1+1 if line<c0 else c0-1
        for a in range(h): out[a][sc]=8
    return out
ok=True
